author: More Perfect Union
description:
Diesel prices just roared past $6 a gallon — an all-time high.

Now truckers are paying up to $1,200 to fill up. Not only are they suffering, their costs are going to hit the whole economy.

Farms, food, clothing, shipping nearly everything, we're all about to feel the impact.

Host: @shellycantsitwithus
Producer: Victoria Hammett
Videographer: Rob Jackson
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: We talked to truck drivers paying $1,200 to fill up. They're PISSED at Trump.
